The tallest mountain in the world above sea level is **Mount Everest**.

* **Elevation:** 8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet) above sea level
* **Location:** Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas, on the border between Nepal and China (Tibet)

---

*(Note: If measured from underwater base to peak, **Mauna Kea** in Hawaii is the tallest at roughly 10,210 m / 33,500 ft, but its peak reaches 4,207 m / 13,803 ft above sea level.)*
